title: Predictions of Fire
creator: Michael Benson
description: An American director’s documentary on Neue Slowenische Kunst, the Slovene art collective of the 1980s whose band, Laibach, provoked both Yugoslav authorities and Western audiences. In English and Slovene.

title: Zizek!
creator: Astra Taylor
place: Faculty of Arts, University of Ljubljana
description: A documentary portrait of Slavoj Žižek, the Ljubljana philosopher, filmed on lecture tours and at home in Ljubljana. In English.

title: Slovenian Girl
creator: Damjan Kozole
description: A student from a small town pays for her life in Ljubljana by working as an escort, calling herself “the Slovenian girl.” A cool, closely observed drama. In Slovene.

title: Houston, We Have a Problem!
creator: Žiga Virc
description: A mock documentary built on a Yugoslav urban legend: that Tito secretly sold Yugoslavia’s space program to the United States. It mixes real archive footage with invented interviews. In Slovene and English.
